name: engagement-os
description: A repeatable operating model for document-heavy consulting engagements, bid to delivery. Composable: scaffold a repo as bid-only, delivery-only, both, or a bare client-research base. Pursuit side: analyse an RFP, research the gaps, write a compliant tender response. Delivery side: ingest client materials to citable markdown, maintain a canonical fact base, write and validate findings, build deliverables through a panel review gate, keep agent memory lean. Every stage is separately invokable — including the final render, which turns any directory of written markdown into a document or hands a manifest to presentation-builder for a deck, then gates the assembled deck on the defects only the package reveals — a flattened picture-per-slide deck, a font neither standard nor embedded, a miscounted splice. Source material is kept separate per phase so bid and delivery evidence never pool. The agent drafts every artefact from what you told it and asks only the residual — you never open a file to fill a template. eng-* skills plus slash-commands, templates, and deterministic scripts — a lint that decides the mechanical invariants (confidentiality leaks, unverified claims in shipped artefacts, unmet mandatory requirements), with a fixture suite proving every rule both ways.
